notes: Strip b: x 1540-2740 plus overlap (x 1240-3040; a few Considine points at x~1210-1220 and Summit/Ivy-Hilary points at x~3065-3093 lie just outside it). W. 8th Street's north line is the plate's top neat line (y~190-194); the cross streets continue north as tabs. Centre of 8th taken between that line and the south block line (~234-240); the solid lines at y~208-222 and the dashed line at ~232-247 are the water pipe and sewer. Grand Avenue (printed 'AVE.' near the top and 'GRAND' at y~5000-5200) drifts east from x~2198 at the top to ~2232 at its south dead end; Hawthorne Avenue (printed 'AVE.' near the top, 'HAWTHORNE' at y~3900-4400) drifts from ~1708 to ~1738. Considine printed 'CONSIDINE' at x~1230, y~4100-4300 (west of the strip). Purcell: printed 'PUR...' on its N-S part west of the strip; the diagonal from Purcell's turn at Murdock (x~910) to the bend at (1491,5233) and the N-S piece to Elberon are the same street (continuous lines and addresses), no name printed in this strip. Elberon Avenue: printed 'ELBERON' on the NNE leg (x~2500, y~5700-5900) and on the NW-SE stretch at the west edge of the plate; the NW leg in this strip carries only 'AVE.'; it is one continuous street (36" sewer, tracks) from the west edge to the hairpin and back NNE. Its points carry ~15 px (interior lines are tracks, pipes and sewers). Littleton is printed 'LITTLETON.' with no suffix (recorded bare). Bassett Road is printed 'ROAD' (west leg) and 'BASSETT RD.' (east leg); width 60' printed in the west leg; labels in the east leg read like 66'/68' (unclear, not recorded). Alpine Way: 'WAY' north of y~3700, 'ALPINE' further south, one street. Hawthorne Place printed 'HAWTHORNE PLACE (PROPOSED)'. Kansas Avenue (printed 'KANSAS' and 'AVE.' along the bottom) runs along the plate's south edge; its outer line is mostly the plate edge. Not streets: the coloured boundary bands (e.g. blue/grey band y~2580-2590 and y~893, the pink/green bands across Alpine at y~3930-3990 and across Elberon at y~5050-5150, the blue band along Grand), the 36" sewer line across the Fuller lot SE of Bassett's end, the 20' strip leaving the boundary line at (2720,3990) toward the SW, the 34' strip south from Nonaly at x~3100, the railroad SE of W. 6th.
